facts.claim: The metropolitan government building is in Nishi-Shinjuku and has observation decks.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: observatory decks on the upper floors

facts.claim: Shinjuku Gyoen is a garden with lawns and grounds formerly used as imperial gardens. The official guide prohibits alcohol, smoking, sporting equipment and musical instruments.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: head to the manicured lawns of Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
